_note: Motion is GSAP-driven for all scroll effects. CSS transitions are only for micro-interactions (hover, focus). Do not use CSS @keyframes for scroll animations.

gsap-reveal.$description: GSAP story reveals and element entrances.

gsap-draw.$description: GSAP SVG path draw (orbital emblem, decorative lines).

gsap-scrub.$description: GSAP scrub timelines. Linear is correct inside scrub.

clouds.$description: Cloud transition scrub lag (slower = more momentum)

emblem.$description: Orbital emblem SVG draw scrub lag

hero.$description: Hero parallax — covers the full sticky hero height

clouds.$description: Cloud transition — triggers as cloud section enters viewport

emblem.$description: Orbital emblem SVG draw — tight trigger window

story.$description: Story line stagger — fires once (not scrubbed)
